title: Ep 23 — OpenAI cuts Cursor loose after a SpaceX takeover, and the AI wrapper that turned two hundred dollars into two million a year
description: OpenAI moves to cut Cursor off from its GPT models by the twelfth of November after SpaceX's acquisition of the company, Google DeepMind pilots the first double-blind evaluation of a frontier AI model inside a cryptographic sandbox, and Anthropic widens Claude for Teachers to full U.S. school districts. Plus a deep dive on Three-Dee AI Studio, founder Jan Hammer's wrapper around commercial text-to-three-dee generation APIs that grew from a two-hundred-dollar build to roughly two million dollars a year in revenue, and why Thursday's Department for Transport charging-point statistics have now missed their own confirmed release date, leaving PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships with real gaps to work with instead of numbers to report.
